name: neftlix

scripts.dev: npm run dev --workspace=server & npm run dev --workspace=web & wait
scripts.start: npm run build && npm run start --workspace=server
scripts.check: npm run check --workspace=server && npm run check --workspace=web && npm run check --workspace=desktop
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=server && npm run test --workspace=desktop

description: Netflix-style client for the IPTV (Xtream Codes) provider you already have: movies, series, live TV and sport.
